semiconductor_relevance: High — Power Cube Semi is involved in the development of SiC MOSFETs and UV LED driver ICs, which are critical components in power semiconductor applications.
summary: Power Cube Semi is a leader in the development of advanced power semiconductors, including the first 2300V SiC MOSFET in South Korea. The company also produces high-speed small UV LED driver ICs, enhancing energy efficiency and reducing heat generation in various applications.
capabilities: High-speed small UV LED driver ICs
Integration of driver ICs into compact PCB designs

regional_presence.Korea: Power Cube Semi is based in South Korea, where it has developed the first 2300V SiC MOSFET.
